technology.title: PGM-FI Technology

The result? Crisp throttle response, lower emissions, and a ride so smooth, you’ll wonder why all bikes don’t feel this effortless. Ride smarter, ride longer, ride better.

technology.title: Refined 348.36cc Engine
technology.description: Raw power meets effortless refinement. With 15.5 kW @ 5500 rpm and 29.4 N-m @ 3000 rpm, this beast delivers seamless acceleration and torque that makes overtaking a breeze. No lags, no hesitations—just instant response and unmatched riding pleasure.

technology.title: 5-Speed Transmission
technology.description: Shift gears like a pro. The perfectly tuned 5-speed gearbox ensures seamless transitions, whether you’re revving up for speed or cruising effortlessly. Every shift is smooth, every ride exhilarating. Because control isn’t just about power—it’s about how effortlessly you wield it. Precision-engineered for those who ride with intent.
